mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_callbacks ( provider, provider_transaction_id, order_id, amount, status, payload_hash ) VALUES ( #{provider}, #{providerTransactionId}, #{orderId}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{payloadHash} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, provider, provider_transaction_id, order_id, amount, status, payload_hash, processed_at FROM payment_callbacks WHERE provider = #{provider} AND provider_transaction_id = #{providerTransactionId}
